# SRA-RiskGate

> Open-source safety checks that run before an AI agent sends a stablecoin (USDC) or x402 payment, and return approve, hold or reject. It has deterministic rules that need no GPU (an offline match against OFAC's published sanctioned crypto addresses, address and amount validation, per-payment limits, USDC depeg checks, detection of self-asserted claims like "risk level: low (verified offline)" in untrusted payment text) plus an optional fine-tuned 4B model, SRA-RiskGate-4B, for a fuller policy and evidence review. Everything fails closed: errors become hold, never approve.

Use it when an agent can transfer tokens, approve token allowances or pay HTTP 402 / x402 requests, for example with Coinbase AgentKit, LangChain agents, the x402 Python SDK or MCP clients such as Claude Desktop and Cursor. Supported: USDC on Ethereum (1), Base (8453), Base Sepolia (84532), Arc (5042) and Arc Testnet (5042002). The OFAC match is an exact address match against a dated snapshot; it is not a sanctions screening service, KYC or legal compliance.

Quick start: `pip install sra-riskgate`, then call `check_payment(chain_id=..., sender=..., recipient=..., amount=..., untrusted_request=...)` before every payment and only pay if the decision is `approve`.

## Docs

- [sra-riskgate (Python SDK)](https://github.com/sriram1983007-dev/sra-riskgate): `check_payment()`, rule pre-filter, claims scan, x402 hooks and Coinbase AgentKit action provider. `pip install sra-riskgate`
- [langchain-sra-riskgate](https://github.com/sriram1983007-dev/langchain-sra-riskgate): LangChain middleware and `guard_tools` that check every money-moving tool call (including AgentKit tools) before it runs. `pip install "langchain-sra-riskgate[middleware]"`
- [sra-riskgate-mcp](https://github.com/sriram1983007-dev/sra-riskgate-mcp): MCP server with `check_payment_rules`, `check_x402_payment` and `check_payment_with_model`. `uvx sra-riskgate-mcp`; registry name `io.github.sriram1983007-dev/sra-riskgate-mcp`
- [agent-payment-guard](https://github.com/sriram1983007-dev/agent-payment-guard): Agent Skill that tells coding agents to run the check before paying. `npx skills add sriram1983007-dev/agent-payment-guard`

## Model and benchmark

- [SRA-RiskGate-4B](https://huggingface.co/sriram1983007/SRA-RiskGate-4B): fine-tuned from Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. On 1,175 held-out synthetic payment cases: 99.5% correct decisions, 0.47% unsafe approvals (base model 34.6%). GGUF and `ollama pull sriram1983007/sra-riskgate` available.
- [sra-stablecoin-risk-bench](https://huggingface.co/datasets/sriram1983007/sra-stablecoin-risk-bench): 20,000 synthetic payment and dispute cases (CC BY 4.0), with a scorer.
- [sra-bench-results](https://huggingface.co/datasets/sriram1983007/sra-bench-results): every published prediction, so results can be re-scored. Results were measured by the author; the benchmark is synthetic and performance on unseen real-world attacks is not yet measured.
